properties.name: namastack.once.jdbc.schema-name
properties.description: Database schema name for once tables (e.g., 'myschema' results in 'myschema.once_marker')

properties.name: namastack.once.jdbc.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix to apply to all once table names (e.g., 'my_' results in 'my_once_marker')

properties.name: namastack.once.jdbc.table-name
properties.description: Base table name for idempotency markers (before prefix and schema are applied)

properties.name: namastack.once.jdbc.schema-initialization.enabled
properties.description: Whether schema initialization is enabled at startup
